sources.title: Hiroshi Ikeda 池田裕 — Encyclopedia of Aikido entry
sources.author: Stanley Pranin / Josh Gold (eds.)
sources.raw_text: Encyclopedia of Aikido entry (the Pranin encyclopedia already cited in the live Wikipedia article): '(b. 1950). 7th dan Aikikai. B. in Hachiojima [sic], Tokyo. Began aikido training under Mitsugi Saotome while a student in the aikido club of Kokugakuin University. Entered Saotome's Reimeijuku dojo in 1970. Relocated to Sarasota, Florida, USA in 1976 and taught in Florida from 1978-79. Moved to Boulder, Colorado in 1980 and established the Boulder Aikikai. Travels extensively around the USA and abroad conducting seminars. Also operates Bujin Design, a martial arts supply company.' Note: 'Hachiojima' is AJ's spelling of Hachijo-jima. Same publisher as the 1995 interview — same editorial entity, not a fully independent confirmation. Archived access point: pre-migration capture https://web.archive.org/web/20110605115217/http://www.aikidojournal.com/encyclopedia?entryID=811 (entryID=811 = IKEDA, HIROSHI; text identical to the migrated entry).
